selection: Freeze3non-control research followups by highest minimum2025two-cost netreturn, then lower worst drawdown, then name. Separately freeze strongest of5static families by same ranking. Followup cohort = union of3research candidates plus cash,beststatic,equal_mix; duplicate roles reuse the same account rather than count independent evidence twice.
budget: At most24screen+24diagnostic+12capacity=60accounts. If frozen followup/control roles overlap, fewer unique accounts; no repeated accounts for reporting count.
execution: At daily strategy decisions or hourly change in covered FOMC risk flag, request delta to fixed unit-gross target*0.8*risk_scale. Request sizes use preceding close and trailing completed-hour volume. Exits persist at1percent actual5mvolume; entryTTLoneinterval. Confirmed exits settle before entry fills. Entry fills additionally bounded by actual gross/equity after all costs and pending exit inventory. Targets can resize existing same-side campaigns; maintain weighted cost basis, cumulative lifecyclePnL and never loosen stops. No free fills or instant flips: same-symbol reversal closes first and waits until next declared rebalance to reopen.
restart: Serialize original config, universe,cash,positions,pending exits,sequence,highwater,halt,previous marks,risk scale,cumulative capacity. Resume only at matching boundary/config/universe/marks. Hold state across years and regime/model switches.
changes_vs_previous: Earlier frozen engine could only shrink and closed positions before later allocating replacement risk; this version can add size within existing campaigns and condition new-symbol fills on confirmed exit risk release. All candidates/controls use the same version. It is still a5mvolume proxy, not native Freqtrade/real-exchange fills; actual order book/min-notional/queue depth not verified.
state_reporting: Attribute each5min NAV change to the pre-known state and event flag at interval start. Report contribution(initial-capital units), active time, within-state complete lifecycle counts and winrate by entry state, plus rolling90day/year diagnostics. Do not concatenate disjoint state slices into a tradable NAV or annualize state contributions.
